english.note: Use 保養 as the all-purpose everyday noun for keeping equipment or systems in good working order.

exampleSentences.english: This air conditioner needs regular maintenance.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢部冷氣機要定期保養。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 bou6 laang5 hei3 gei1 jiu3 ding6 kei4 bou2 joeng5

english.note: Use this for maintaining an object, body, or system in good condition.

exampleSentences.english: The air conditioner needs regular care to last longer.
exampleSentences.traditional: 部冷氣要定期保養，先可以用耐啲。
exampleSentences.jyutping: bou6 laang5 hei3 jiu3 ding6 kei4 bou2 joeng5 sin1 ho2 ji5 jung6 noi6 di1

english.note: Use 保養 for a vehicle or engine service that includes tuning and maintenance.

exampleSentences.english: The engine runs much more smoothly after a tune and service.
exampleSentences.traditional: 部車做完保養之後，引擎順咗好多。
exampleSentences.jyutping: bou6 ce1 zou6 jyun4 bou2 joeng5 zi1 hau6 jan5 king4 seon6 zo2 hou2 do1
